fact: Angola presents a phased Bilhete de Identidade Digital, with an authentication capability, a digital identity wallet app and fingerprint, face, iris and biometric signature enrolment at birth registration and ID issue, as its target architecture.

Angop reports Cabinda province now issues more than 200 Bilhete de Identidade cards a day, delivered in under 24 hours since printing was decentralised in June 2026.

The Secretary of State for Justice says printing of the Bilhete de Identidade was decentralised to all 21 provinces from June 2026, issuing it in 24 to 48 hours with biometric data collected by mobile brigades.
Secretary of State for Justice Osvaldo Amaro said 16,297,777 Angolans hold the Bilhete de Identidade and that printing is being decentralised to speed issuance.
Justice minister Marcy Lopes says Angola has over 15 million citizens holding the Bilhete de Identidade and issues 12,000 a day, with identity certified before issue.
